brief:
Egypt and Qatar renewed their call Thursday for all parties to honor their commitments under President Donald Trump's plan to end Israel's war on Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. Both countries emphasized the necessity of moving forward with implementation of the agreement.

The joint statement from the two mediators came as negotiations over the ceasefire proposal continued. Egypt and Qatar have played central roles in diplomatic efforts to halt the military operations in Gaza. The appeal followed weeks of discussions among Israeli officials, Hamas representatives, and international mediators seeking to establish terms for ending the conflict.
